feedback: Written before this robot races. Iteration 3 (±0.03 m at 16 mm, kp 1.2) scored 69.46, up from 63.85 at iteration 2. Progress rose on the oval (0.184) and s-bend (0.210), and line loss persisted at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run. Max error held near 0.062 m on every track, so the off-track limit is still the binding failure. S-bend oscillation rose to 0.168, while slalom oscillation held at 0.145. Your ±0.04 m row at 16 mm extends the coverage edge to about 0.0605 m, which is the direction the line-loss evidence supports. I have lowered kp to 1.0, because the wider spacing shallows the steering slope and the s-bend oscillation exceeded the 0.16 trigger. Do not expect a result from the current candidate. When it races, read line-loss events after progress 0.1 on the s-bend and oval, and s-bend oscillation. If line loss moves past the 0.06 limit or disappears, hold the ±0.04 row. If s-bend oscillation is still above 0.16 at this gain, the 16 mm footprint is probably adding edge noise, so try a 12 mm footprint with the same spacing.
requested_changes: Hold sensor_positions at x = -0.04 to 0.04 in 0.02 m steps, y = 0.04, sensor_size 0.016, for the next race, so the controller is judged on the coverage change.
If s-bend oscillation stays above 0.16 at kp 1.0 with the wider row, try sensor_size 0.012 at the same positions to test whether 16 mm footprint noise is the cause.

Keep the forward offset at y = 0.04 unless slalom oscillation reaches 0.15 or more. If line loss begins near progress 0 rather than on bends, hold the geometry and ask the Integrator to examine start-up speed and entry gain.
